verdicts.reason: A keeps the diamond photo collage, brown address/date diamonds, headline, rule and body copy intact, but it is mostly a scaled copy: the photo collage no longer bleeds off the left edge and leaves a thin white strip there, and the hierarchy is unchanged, so it needs polish rather than a redesign. B is unusable: the photo collage is gone, leaving one small square photo and an empty wireframe of diamond outlines. The two brown diamonds float apart from each other, the divider rule is stranded in white space away from the headline, the URL sits vertically in the middle of the canvas, and the headline and body text are small and pushed to the bottom with large dead areas everywhere.
